Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-figure PIXEL ART walk sheet for an existing native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input1=EXACT APPEARANCE, VIEW DIRECTION, COLORS and PROPORTIONS master. Input2=accepted FOUR-PAW movement guide ONLY. NEVER copy guide's hooked head, neck, body shape, species, colors, dark dome, face, limb lengths or equipment. Change locomotion only, preserving each master's silhouette and materials.
CRITICAL anatomy: walk on ALL FOUR EXISTING LIMBS, three or four paws supporting weight during transitions. Keep low horizontal body and original limb lengths; no upright pose, rearing, bipedal step, dangling front arms, human waist, long legs, added head or added appendages. Very small low steps, no splaying or high lift.
Layout EXACT3equal columns x3equal rows, row-major first8DISTINCT full figures, ninth low four-paw idle. Phases:1fore-right/hind-left support,2weight settles over three paws,3fore-left advances LOW while other paws support,4opposite group sets down,5stable opposite support,6weight shifts low over three paws,7fore-right advances low and hind-left follows,8returns to first group contact.400ms per advancement,800ms full cycle. No simultaneous forequarter lift, hopping, running, skating or whole-body zoom. Minimal coherent bob, constant low volume/camera/proportions.
Draw WHOLE connected figures, never graft legs, move pixel bands or detach a head. Slight elevated front/rear game camera, parallel square-grid axes. No side-view camera or isometric diamond.
Match original MUTED MATTE colors, deep dark shadows, warm unbleached flesh and crisp deliberate native64 pixel clusters. No brighter/white skin, yellow highlights, silver gloss, rimlight, glow, HDsmooth painting, blur, grain or3D. Colored fringe specks in master are export specks, not anatomy/lights.
Genuine transparent alphaZERO background/limb gaps, generous empty cell margins, every paw and body complete, no crop/overlap. NO floor, shadow, matte, grid, checkerboard, text, labels or watermark.
NATIVE silhouette 48pxWIDE by31pxHIGH, width/height1.548. This is a WIDE LOW creature. Target complete figure330px wide and about213px high in each square cell; DO NOT inflate into a tall body, stretch limbs, enlarge it or narrow its trunk.
SUBJECT: Low pale cream/peach FLESH MOUND with red creases across its rounded back and exactly FOUR short weight-bearing clawed limbs, two fore and two hind. Preserve its existing red frontal round mouth/opening with dark interior, dark pointed claw tips and pale fleshy shoulders. It has NO separate human head, neck, torso or arms. Do not add shell plates, spikes, horns, fangs, eyes, tail or extra limbs.
VIEW: FRONT/slight front-three-quarter walking DOWN/TOWARD viewer, like identity master. Keep original front opening and every material feature in the same place while all FOUR paws carry weight. Two forepaws near viewer, hind supports behind them, existing occlusion preserved.
